summary: Mars CLI opens a persistent remote-control channel to wss://cho100.cn that drives a local coding agent on the installer's host
details: The package's `mars` bin, invoked via `npx @aubea/mars`, prints a QR code for pairing and then daemonizes into the background (PID at `~/.mars/daemon.pid`, logs at `~/.mars/daemon.log`) while holding open a WebSocket connection to the hardcoded relay `wss://cho100.cn/mars-relay`. Messages received from that relay are dispatched into a local Claude Code / Codex ACP client (`session/new`, `session/prompt`, tool-use routing) which reads and writes files and executes tools on the installer's machine. Any party paired via the QR code, or anyone controlling the relay host `cho100.cn`, can drive arbitrary file edits and tool/command execution on the host. The daemon detaches from the terminal so the remote-control channel persists after the invoking shell is closed.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
